rules.universe: Every path returned by git ls-files is represented exactly once.
rules.full_read: Read the complete textual content in later exhaustive exploration, including implementation, tests, examples, benchmarks, docs, build/CI/container/deployment configuration.
rules.binary: Inventory metadata only; do not decode media or compiled artifacts as source.
rules.translations: Inventory docs/source/locale and gettext catalogs only; architecture semantics come from canonical source/docs.
rules.generated: Inventory generated Operator artifacts only; analyze their handwritten generators/types/builders instead.
rules.symlinks: Inventory the link and, during full read, resolve and read the tracked target when it is in scope.
rules.safety: Static reading/parsing only; do not import or execute project modules during exploration.
